meta.source: don-chuys.com (computed styles, Sep 2026) + Lunch Time / Daily Specials posters · v2 web expansion (scales, semantic grounds, web type scale) · v3 Cantina Slab type (Ultra / Yellowtail / Figtree) + creative web elements · v4 site palette + flat editorial look · v5 brand display face Eudora (Runsell Studio, supplied by the brand)

tokens.name: cream
tokens.usage: Warm paper for collage/editorial blocks and BrandPaper. No longer the page ground in v4.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: v4 default page ground (the site runs on white): pages, cards, inputs, nav bar.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Warm cream ground for menus, editorial blocks and pattern backgrounds. Direction from the moodboard, not on the current site.

tokens.name: paper-deep
tokens.usage: Sunken cream: menu panels, image placeholders, dividers on `paper`. `ink` 11:1.

tokens.name: sage-100
tokens.usage: Tinted section ground for alternating bands; `agave` text 6.8:1.

tokens.name: sage-200
tokens.usage: Pattern ink on `sage-100`, soft plate backdrops.

tokens.name: sage
tokens.usage: Poster ground from the Lunch Time / Daily Specials social pieces. Social only in v4; the web uses `teal-surface`.

tokens.name: sage-alt
tokens.usage: Slightly greener poster ground used on the Daily Specials story. Same text rules as `sage`.

tokens.name: ornament
tokens.usage: Talavera-style border ornaments printed on `sage`. Decorative only, never text.

tokens.name: agave
tokens.usage: Poster day-pill green. Social only in v4; the web uses `navy` / `teal-700`.

tokens.name: agave-900
tokens.usage: Deepest green: footer and night bands. `on-brand` 13:1, `marigold` 6:1, `paper-deep` 9.5:1.

tokens.name: teal
tokens.usage: The site's accent teal: tile lattice, sunburst, large accent text (24px+ on `surface`, 3.3:1). For small text use `teal-700`.

tokens.name: teal-surface
tokens.usage: The site's About-band teal: Daily Specials board ground. `ink` 4.9:1; white only 24px+ (3.25:1).

tokens.name: teal-100
tokens.usage: Tint of the site's teal for alternating sections, dish tiles and tab hovers. `ink` 13:1, `teal-700` 5:1, `navy` 8.3:1.

tokens.name: teal-700
tokens.usage: Deep shade of the site's teal: newsletter band, WordStack/poster fields, eyebrows and icons. `on-dark` text 6:1; as text on `surface` 6:1.

tokens.name: teal-ink
tokens.usage: Teal as TEXT and icons on `surface`, `cream`, `teal-100` (6:1 light, 7.8:1 dark): eyebrows, social handle, location icons.

tokens.name: chuy-rose
tokens.usage: Primary brand colour from the site: logo wordmark, hero colour band, footer, tabs, marquee, location names. `on-dark` text 6.5:1.

tokens.name: rose-100
tokens.usage: Blush tint behind promos and highlighted menu items; `ink` 12.8:1, `deep-red` 8:1.

tokens.name: chuy-red
tokens.usage: The site's CTA red: primary buttons, outline buttons, active nav link, spicy markers. White text 4.8:1.

tokens.name: deep-red
tokens.usage: Headline text on `surface` or `paper` (10:1 / 8:1). Dark theme lightens it to 5.5:1 on dark `surface`.

tokens.name: marigold
tokens.usage: The site's active-nav orange: ColorSplit and promo blocks, stickers, flowers, highlights. `ink`/`navy`/`deep-red` text on it (7.2 / 4.5 / 4.5:1).

tokens.name: marigold-100
tokens.usage: Warm tint for Happy Hour and notices; `ink` 13.5:1. On `chuy-rose` it reads 5.5:1 as text.

tokens.name: marigold-700
tokens.usage: Orange as TEXT: prices and kickers on `cream`/`paper` (5.5:1); dark theme uses `marigold` (7.1:1).

tokens.name: navy
tokens.usage: The site's navy: day pills, stack-hero bar, secondary buttons, WordStack/category fields. White 9.9:1.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text on `surface`, `paper` and `sage` (5.5:1 on sage). Also the site's dark footer band in light theme.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: addresses, hours, captions on `surface` and `paper`.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `chuy-rose`, `chuy-red`, `agave`, `navy`.

tokens.name: on-marigold
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `marigold` and `marigold-100` fills.

tokens.name: on-dark
tokens.usage: Cream text on dark and saturated grounds in BOTH themes: `agave` 7.5:1, `agave-900` 13:1, `chuy-rose` 5.9:1, `navy`.

tokens.name: script-ink
tokens.usage: Yellowtail script accents on `cream`, `paper`, `surface` (5.9:1 light; `marigold` 7.1:1 on dark `cream`). On dark or saturated grounds use `marigold` or `on-dark` instead.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and input borders on `surface` and `cream` (decorative; pair with a label).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring: 3px solid, 2px offset. 8.9:1 on `cream` light; 7.1:1 on dark `cream`.

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Scrim over photos under white text (hero, promo).

styles.name: display-2xl
styles.usage: Hero headlines and the WordStack. Mobile: 64px. Eudora, rendered in its lowercase set (clean caps; `i` draws as the brand `!`). Missing glyphs (' ! $ - & accents) fall back to Bebas Neue.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Promo bands, page titles. Mobile: 56px. Eudora, rendered in its lowercase set (clean caps; `i` draws as the brand `!`). Missing glyphs (' ! $ - & accents) fall back to Bebas Neue.

styles.name: display-l
styles.usage: Section titles. Mobile: 44px. Eudora, rendered in its lowercase set (clean caps; `i` draws as the brand `!`). Missing glyphs (' ! $ - & accents) fall back to Bebas Neue.

styles.name: display-m
styles.usage: Menu categories, board titles. Mobile: 36px. Eudora, rendered in its lowercase set (clean caps; `i` draws as the brand `!`). Missing glyphs (' ! $ - & accents) fall back to Bebas Neue.

styles.name: display-s
styles.usage: Card titles, dish names, location names. Eudora, rendered in its lowercase set (clean caps; `i` draws as the brand `!`). Missing glyphs (' ! $ - & accents) fall back to Bebas Neue.

styles.name: script-xl
styles.usage: The one-word accent inside display headlines (≈0.7× the display size), rotated −6°, in `script-ink`. Mobile: 44px.

styles.name: script-l
styles.usage: Stickers, kickers, notes and captions with personality.

styles.name: script-m
styles.usage: Menu notes, footer tagline.
